source_entry_from_manual_corpus.title: Planning London Datahub applications
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.publisher: Greater London Authority / London planning authorities
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.licence: London Datastore dataset page lists Licence: Not Specified; this candidate file stores factual metadata, source row URLs, and derived representative coordinates pending reuse review.
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.time_coverage: Selected records from 2008-2026 in the Round119 architecture corpus window.
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.spatial_granularity: Greater London planning authorities, including boroughs, LLDC, and OPDC-style planning authority feeds where present.
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.temporal_granularity: id lpa_name lpa_app_no site_name description decision status decision_date application_details.scheme_name application_details.residential_details.total_no_proposed_residential_units application_details.total_gia_gained application_details.building_details wgs84_polygon centroid url_planning_app
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.update_frequency: Daily according to the London Datastore dataset page and existing source registry notes.
source_entry_from_manual_corpus.limitations: PLD rows are administrative planning records and not evidence of construction, completion, occupation, opening, or effects. Borough feed coverage, backfill, status, and centroid quality vary. Candidate coordinates are representative navigation points from PLD geometry. Use for selected administrative planning milestones where source row id, LPA reference, date field, geometry caveat, and limitations remain visible. Administrative planning decision row only. It is not evidence of demolition, construction start, completion, occupation, opening, delivery of homes/floorspace/public realm, design quality, or impacts. PLD status and geometry can vary by authority feed and should be checked against the local planning-register documents before publication.

required_caveats: Planning London Datahub lifecycle dates are administrative source fields, not independent site observations.
Do not treat actual_completion_date or actual_commencement_date as proof of completed/opened/occupied final built form without site-specific corroboration.
Licence is listed as Not Specified on the London Datastore page.
